messages.subject: Shipment Request #TRN-2026-001 – Steel Rods
messages.body:
Dear Rohan,

Please arrange for 500 units of hot‑rolled steel rods (length 6 ft, grade A) to be dispatched to our Delhi warehouse. Our internal reference is TRN‑2026‑001. The total invoice amount is INR 4,75,000. We need the consignment to arrive no later than 2026‑06‑20 to meet our production schedule. Kindly confirm the expected ETA and share the pro‑forma invoice at the earliest.

Thank you,
Arjun Mehta
Procurement Manager, Global Traders Ltd.

messages.subject: Re: Shipment Request #TRN-2026-001 – Follow‑up
messages.body:
Hi Rohan,

Following up on the steel rods request sent on June 5, we would like to add an extra 200 units of the same specification to the order, raising the total to INR 6,30,000. Please let us know if this amendment affects the delivery date. If the revised shipment can still be delivered by June 22, that would be ideal. Awaiting your updated pro‑forma.

Best regards,
Arjun Mehta
Global Traders Ltd.

messages.subject: New Shipment Request #TRN-2026-002 – PVC Pipes
messages.body:
Dear Rohan,

We need 300 pieces of 1½‑inch PVC drainage pipes (white, PN 16) for our upcoming construction project. The items are listed under reference TRN‑2026‑002 with a total value of INR 1,12,500. Kindly schedule dispatch to reach our Delhi site by 2026‑07‑22. Please forward the shipping schedule and invoice details.

Thanks,
Arjun Mehta
Procurement, Global Traders Ltd.

messages.subject: Urgent Shipment Request #TRN-2026-003 – Copper Wire
messages.body:
Hi Rohan,

Due to an unexpected surge in demand, we urgently require 200 kg of 2.5 mm² copper wire, reference TRN‑2026‑003. The total cost is INR 2,40,000. We would appreciate if the consignment can be dispatched within the next three days and delivered by 2026‑08‑05. Please confirm availability and shipping arrangements.

Regards,
Arjun Mehta
Global Traders Ltd.

messages.subject: Shipment Request #TRN-2026-004 – Galvanized Nails
messages.body:
Dear Rohan,

Please supply 1,500 units of 3‑inch galvanized nails (pack of 100) for our hardware inventory. This order is logged as TRN‑2026‑004 and totals INR 78,900. We would like the shipment to arrive no later than 2026‑08‑27. Kindly issue the invoice and share the tracking number once the goods are dispatched.

Thank you,
Arjun Mehta
Procurement, Global Traders Ltd.

messages.subject: Final Shipment Request #TRN-2026-005 – Safety Helmets
messages.body:
Hi Rohan,

We are placing a final order of 100 industrial safety helmets (ANSI‑Z89.1 certified, size M/L) under reference TRN‑2026‑005. The total amount is INR 1,05,000. Please arrange dispatch so the items reach our Delhi office by 2026‑09‑10. Let us know if any documentation is required from our side.

Best,
Arjun Mehta
Global Traders Ltd.
